name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Bauer goes with either Captain or Ganymede (but not both).
Fontaine, Geologist, and Ganymede belong to different colonists.
Engineer goes with either Fontaine or Luna (but not both).
Earth goes with neither Fontaine nor Captain.
Luna goes with at least one of Cho, Engineer, or Geologist.
Luna goes with neither Captain nor Geologist.
Anders, Captain, and Ganymede belong to different colonists.
Fontaine goes with neither Botanist nor Venus.
Bauer goes with none of Engineer, Geologist, or Ganymede.
